expected.note: [59-61], [79-80], [400-402] 'I'll also draft a note to send that we're going to delay the releases' / summary 'I'll send an email to communicate the delay.' Speaker unnamed (the summary is presumably the host Jeremy, but he is not named as owner) -> null. 'today' in [401] is about the Go bumps, not the email.

[175-184], [403-406] 'action item will have an updated playbook for like what to do after the final release' / 'we assigned a action item to Marco to kind of do a update of the post-release playbook specifically to add OBS related stuff'. Real name is Marko (Mudrinic); Whisper writes 'Marco' ([403]) and 'Marcos' ([92]), so 'Marco' is used. 'next week' in [181] is about the alpha 2 cut, not the playbook.

[289-312], [407-409] 'Would it be okay if I started an email thread with sick architecture and sick release' -> 'I think that Mario should start it. Mario, you want to take that?' 'Yeah, I can't [can] do this' / summary 'Mario is going to start a discussion between sig release and sig arch about talking about endpoint coverage'.

[208-218], [302] 'reaching out for their own things for those end points' / 'for 132, we just need to ping the folks' / 'This I will basically ping the sick directly'. Mario raised the topic and is the likely speaker, but the ping is said without an explicit name; may also be folded into the SIG Arch discussion item.

[74-78] 'get those over the line, which I will try to work on this afternoon' / 'I will start dropping the holds and follow through'. Debatable: continuation of the patch-release work the speaker already owns; speaker unnamed.

[362-379] 'we may still want to consider a cap [KEP] even if it's super lightweight' / 'I would plus one that'. Hedged suggestion, no owner named (Adolfo presented the topic); Whisper writes KEP as 'get'/'cap'.
[380-386] 'I would really like to start working on ... maybe a POC'. Personal plan by the presenter (Adolfo), hedged.
[388-392] 'I'll probably go maybe next week to some of the security meetings, probably security tooling'. Hedged personal plan.
[414-433] KubeCon meetup: 'you can for sure put something up' / 'We could go buy some post-[its] and some sharpies ... I live next to a craft store'. Informal logistics, no clear decision.
